stories.title: Carer who murdered vulnerable teenager and claimed her benefits dies in jail
stories.summary: Avril Jones, 66, and her partner Edward Cairney murdered the vulnerable teenager around the turn of the century.

stories.title: Will civil servants strike for the right to work from home?
stories.summary: A new Scottish government hybrid-working policy is being enforced.

stories.title: Aberdeen sack Robinson after league slump
stories.summary: Aberdeen sack head coach Stephen Robinson after dropping to second bottom of the Scottish Premiership.

stories.title: Senior doctors at Glasgow hospital in care delay warning
stories.summary: Consultants at the Queen Elizabeth University Hospital say conditions for emergency patients there are deteriorating.

stories.title: Hydro unlikely to host more bare-knuckle boxing after mass brawl, BBC understands
stories.summary: Three police officers were injured and two men arrested after the large disturbance broke out following the Ovo Hydro show.

stories.title: We were sightseeing in Krakow and had sat down for drinks - then the shooting began
stories.summary: Charlie Hutchison and Ciaran McMenemy, from Aberdeen, managed to take shelter during a mass shooting in the Polish city at the weekend.

stories.title: 'No risk' after bomb squad called and premises evacuated in Larkhall
stories.summary: Police said the item found on Broomhill Road had been identified and was of no risk to the public.

stories.title: Nine Aberdeen break-ins being linked by detectives
stories.summary: Jewellery and money has been taken in the "concerning" incidents in Aberdeen in recent days.

stories.title: DJ Hannah Laing makes 'heartbreaking' decision to cancel 2027 Doof in the Park
stories.summary: She said behind the scenes issues had left insufficient time to deliver the Dundee event to the 'standard you all know'.

stories.title: West Highland Line closed for nine days for £13m upgrade
stories.summary: Buses will replace trains between Crianlarich and Fort William/Mallaig until Tuesday 17 November.

stories.title: Woman says Al Fayed's brother drugged and sexually abused her at Highland estate
stories.summary: The woman says she was flown to the Fayed family's Balnagown estate, where she was repeatedly assaulted.

stories.title: Driver killed in two-car crash on A94 in Angus named
stories.summary: The 34-year-old man was driving an Audi A1 when it was involved in a crash with a Ford Focus near Glamis on Thursday night.
